description: `.temp` sets the one temperature, in degrees Celsius, that every analysis of the deck runs at. It takes exactly one value above absolute zero, once per deck. SPICE reads a list of temperatures as one run per temperature; this simulator runs a deck once, and picking one value of the list would give an answer at a temperature the deck did not single out, so a list is refused instead.
actions: For several temperatures, run the deck once per temperature, editing the card between runs.
Remove a second `.temp` card: the deck can set the temperature only once.
